scripts.k8s:image:load: docker build -t banking-event-sourcing:latest . && kind load docker-image banking-event-sourcing:latest --name banking
scripts.k8s:deploy: kubectl apply -f k8s/postgres/ -f k8s/postgres-read/ -f k8s/redis/ -f k8s/kafka/ -f k8s/app/ -n banking
scripts.k8s:undeploy: kubectl delete -f k8s/postgres/ -f k8s/postgres-read/ -f k8s/redis/ -f k8s/kafka/ -f k8s/app/ -n banking --ignore-not-found
scripts.k8s:restart: kubectl rollout restart deployment/banking-app -n banking && kubectl rollout status deployment/banking-app -n banking
